steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, W=g.world, P=g.player; __rhf.god(true); g.bears.directorT=9999; window.__banners=[]; const ban=g.hud.banner.bind(g.hud); g.hud.banner=(m,c,s)=>{ __banners.push(m+(s?' / '+s:'')); return ban(m,c,s); }; window.__toasts=[]; const to=g.hud.toast.bind(g.hud); g.hud.toast=(m,k)=>{ __toasts.push(m); return to(m,k); }; const pl=W.place('landing'); P.place(pl.x,pl.z,pl.face||0); let spot=null; for (const d of [10,14,18]) for (const a of [0,-30,30]) { const yaw=(pl.face||0)+a*Math.PI/180; const x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(yaw)*d, z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(yaw)*d; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if (!spot&&w&&w.depth>0.6) spot={x,z,w}; } window.__spot=spot; window.__wait=()=>{ f.cancel(); f.water=spot.w; f.float.position.set(spot.x,spot.w.level,spot.z); f.floatBase=spot.w.level; f.float.visible=true; f.state='waiting'; }; return spot?'water at '+spot.x.toFixed(0)+','+spot.z.toFixed(0):'no water'; })()
steps.label: a spot with deep water is found off the landing

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); const e=f.encounter; e.phase='bite'; e.t=e.window*0.2; f.hook(); const F=f.fight; const r='quick hook set: clean '+F.clean+', fish stamina '+F.stamina+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners.slice(-1)); __wait(); f.startEncounter(); const e2=f.encounter; e2.phase='bite'; e2.t=e2.window*0.8; __banners.length=0; f.hook(); const F2=f.fight; const r2=' | late hook set: clean '+F2.clean+', fish stamina '+F2.stamina+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners.slice(-1)); f.cancel(); return r+r2; })()
steps.label: a hook set early in the take is a perfect hookset with the fish at 0.85 stamina; a late one is a plain FISH ON at full stamina
steps.expect: (([a, b]) => /^quick hook set: clean true, fish stamina 0\.85, banners \[.*PERFECT HOOKSET.*\]$/.test(a) && /^late hook set: clean false, fish stamina 1, banners \["FISH ON!"\]$/.test(b))(r.split(' | '))

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); f.encounter.phase='bite'; f.encounter.t=0; f.hook(); const F=f.fight; const before=F.stamina; F.state='jump'; F.stateT=1.15; F.jumpT=0.44; F.jumpChecked=false; F.dist=Math.max(F.dist,8); __toasts.length=0; f.updateFight(0.05,false,g.input); const bowed=F.bows; const after=F.stamina; F.state='run'; F.stateT=5; F.dir=1; F.rodSide=1; F.turnT=0; F.turned=false; g.input.stick.active=true; g.input.stick.x=1; for (let i=0;i<20;i++) f.updateFight(0.1,false,g.input); g.input.stick.active=false; g.input.stick.x=0; const r='bowed to the jump: bows '+bowed+', stamina '+before.toFixed(2)+' -> '+after.toFixed(2)+', turns '+F.turns+', after the turn the fish '+F.state+' and the drag '+(g.audio.screamOn?'on':'off')+', toasts '+JSON.stringify(__toasts); f.cancel(); return r; })()

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, s=g.state; s.stats.streak=0; s.cooler.length=0; const out=[]; for (let i=0;i<3;i++) { f.fight={fish:{species:'coho',weight:3.4,legend:null}, clean:i===0, bows:i===1?2:0, turns:0}; f.finishCatch(); out.push('catch '+(i+1)+': value '+f.catchInfo.value+', bonus '+JSON.stringify(f.catchInfo.bonus)+', card bonus line '+JSON.stringify(document.getElementById('catch-bonus').hidden?'(hidden)':document.getElementById('catch-bonus').textContent)); document.getElementById('catch-release').click(); } f.fight={fish:{species:'coho',weight:3.4,legend:null}}; f.state='fight'; f.lose('test',false,null); out.push('after a lost fish: streak '+s.stats.streak); return out.join(' | '); })()
steps.label: catch bonuses: perfect hookset +10%, two bows +10%, a streak of 2 and 3 +10%/+20%, shown on the card; a lost fish ends the streak
steps.expect: (() => { const p = r.split(' | '); if (p.length !== 4) return false; const v = p.slice(0, 3).map((s) => +s.match(/value (\d+)/)[1]); return /bonus \["Perfect hookset \+10%"\], card bonus line "Perfect hookset \+10%"$/.test(p[0]) && /bonus \["Bowed to 2 jumps \+10%","2 in a row \+10%"\], card bonus line "Bowed to 2 jumps \+10% · 2 in a row \+10%"$/.test(p[1]) && /bonus \["3 in a row \+20%"\], card bonus line "3 in a row \+20%"$/.test(p[2]) && v[1] === v[2] && v[1] > v[0] && Math.abs(v[1] / v[0] - 1.2 / 1.1) < 0.03 && p[3] === 'after a lost fish: streak 0'; })()

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, s=g.state; s.cooler.length=0; while (s.cooler.length<s.coolerCap()) s.cooler.push({species:'grayling',weight:0.5,length:30,value:50+s.cooler.length,legend:null,name:'Arctic Grayling'}); const cheapest=s.cheapestInCooler(); f.fight={fish:{species:'king',weight:12,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); const keep=document.getElementById('catch-keep'); const r='full cooler, valuable catch: button '+JSON.stringify(keep.firstChild.textContent)+', disabled '+keep.disabled+', info '+JSON.stringify(document.getElementById('catch-info').textContent); keep.click(); const has=s.cooler.some(c=>c.species==='king'); const gone=!s.cooler.includes(cheapest); f.fight={fish:{species:'grayling',weight:0.3,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); const r2=' | kept the king '+has+', cheapest gone '+gone+', cooler '+s.cooler.length+'/'+s.coolerCap()+' | cheap catch: button '+JSON.stringify(keep.firstChild.textContent)+', disabled '+keep.disabled; document.getElementById('catch-release').click(); s.cooler.length=0; return r+r2; })()
steps.label: a full cooler offers Swap for a better fish, swaps out the cheapest and stays full; a cheaper catch cannot be kept
steps.expect: /^full cooler, valuable catch: button "Swap", disabled false, info ".*Swap.*" \| kept the king true, cheapest gone true, cooler (\d+)\/\1 \| cheap catch: button "Keep", disabled true$/.test(r)

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); const mean=(n)=>{ let s=0; for (let i=0;i<n;i++) s+=f.approachDelay(); return s/n; }; let mx=0; for (let i=0;i<2000;i++) mx=Math.max(mx,f.approachDelay()); const m0=mean(400); __banners.length=0; f.startFrenzy(); const m1=mean(400); f.startEncounter(); const skip=f.encounter.skipNibble; const r='wait: mean '+m0.toFixed(1)+' s, longest of 2000 '+mx.toFixed(1)+' s | frenzy: here '+f.frenzyHere()+', mean wait '+m1.toFixed(1)+' s, straight to the take '+skip+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners); f.frenzy=null; f.cancel(); return r; })()
steps.label: bite waits are capped at 2.5x the mean; a feeding frenzy here shortens them and skips the nibbles

steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.nextApproach=30; f.encounter=null; const base=f.nextApproach; __toasts.length=0; const tw=()=>{ g.input.pressedOnce=true; f.updateWaiting(0.01,true,false,false); }; f.t=100; tw(); const a=f.nextApproach; f.t=100.3; tw(); f.t=100.6; tw(); f.t=100.9; tw(); const b=f.nextApproach; f.cancel(); return 'twitch after a pause: wait '+base.toFixed(1)+' -> '+a.toFixed(1)+' | a flurry of three: '+b.toFixed(1)+', toasts '+JSON.stringify(__toasts); })()

steps.expect: (() => { const p = r.split(' | '); if (p.length !== 6) return false; const g = p[4].match(/^goal line (\S+) \(map marker on (.+?)\) then (\S+) \(map marker on (.+?)\), open (\[.*\])$/); if (!g) return false; const open = JSON.parse(g[5]); const lvl = +(p[5].match(/^fight music level with a bare fight (-?[\d.]+)$/) || [])[1]; return p[0] === 'rod creak 0.9 before a snap, 0 after' && /^a fish on the line dropped: streak 0, toasts \[.*"Your run of 4 ends".*\]$/.test(p[1]) && p[2] === 'a press held into a reel counted as a twitch: false, a tap: true' && /^a card closed by something else with a full cooler: kings in the cooler 0, graylings [1-9]\d*$/.test(p[3]) && g[1] === open[0] && g[3] === open[1] && g[1] !== g[3] && (g[1] !== 'sell' || g[2] === 'post') && lvl > 0 && lvl < 0.35; })()
